programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Charlie is crumbling under the weight of his lies. Meanwhile, the village gathers for Rex and Ste's wedding. And Diane's determined to create a day of happy memories for her family.

programme.title: New: Married at First Sight...
programme.desc: ...Australia - Brand new series: The experiment is almost over. The couples reunite for one more tabletop tête-à-tête, and a bride's furious about her groom texting someone else.

programme.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
programme.desc: Brand new series: James Haskell gets a date with pageant queen Zara. Has Lucinda Light finally met her match? Coleen Nolan has dinner with Andy, but is she thinking of Steve?

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: On the box this time: Peaky Blinders, Love Is Blind, Coronation Street, Celebrity Hunted, Starstruck, Celebrity Mastermind, This Morning, and BBC News (Ukraine).
